verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation, compliance, bookkeeping and tax service, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes external tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows any agent host or tool-consuming capability that would make the axis apply; 'AI-powered' bookkeeping and 'Advanced API integrations' do not count as MCP client support.
